Question
========

Which command installs the `readxl` package?

Answerlist
----------

- `get.packages("readxl")`
- `install.packages(readxl)`
- `install.packages("readxl")`
- `library("readxl")`

Solution
========
::: {.callout-note title="Solution"}
Use `install.packages("readxl")` to install the package. The package name must
be string, so needing surrounding quotation marks `"readxl"`. `library(readxl)`
is a correct R function, but loads an already-installed package.
:::
